label: In Aquinas' ST I q.3 a.4 first proof, each actually existing…, by Typed-disjunction-elimination…
meaning: For every subject actually existing at the esse respect with a distinct essence and esse, the open dichotomy yields either sufficient efficient causation by essential principles alone or an actually existing distinct external cause at esse. The independently open no-self-cause premise eliminates the first branch. This is a conditional transcription of Aquinas' argumentative structure, not a proof of either metaphysical premise.
